Name: Super Saiyan Rose SSR Goku black weapons retextures
Author: wcaxeman
Description:
这是我第一次做mod，我目前只会画贴图，如果有建议或者技术上的指导欢迎评论留言。
This is the first time I’ve done mod, I only know how to draw textures so far, please leave a comment if you have any suggestions or technical instructions
1.21.1
Replace Lava Katana, Dragontooth Cutlass and Golden Scythe with Super Saiyan Rose Ki Blade, Divine Lassso broadsword and Rose Ki scythe, respectively. 将熔岩武士刀、龙牙弯刀和金色镰刀分别换成超级赛亚人桃红气刃、神超神裂乱舞大刀和桃红镰刀

1.21.2

Now with the new verion mod and advanced special attack you can use divine lasso 更新了mod，配合advanced special attack这个mod，整了一个伪·超神裂乱舞

1.21.3 update  1.21.3更新

My “Divine Lasso”Scimitar was created in DBXV2, but it didn’t work very well, so I modified the scimitar’s texture to align the scimitar with the general air blade style. In addition, I also processed the Iridium Axe and the iridium pickaxe in SSR style. 之前我的超神裂乱舞弯刀是参考龙珠超宇宙2的样子做的，但是我觉得不太好看，所以我修改了弯刀的纹理，使之与一般的气刀风格相一致。另外，我还加工了桃红色风格的铱镐和铱镐

In addition, I added a new weapon retexture, in version 1.21.3 -- replacing the Galactic Hammer with the GreatSword of judgement in the DarkSouls III , and if you use this mod with ASA, you will be able to cast the spell of Pontiff Sulyvahn with the Sword of judgement. Have a good time. 另外，我在1.21.3版本中增加了一个新的武器再纹理---- 用黑暗之魂3的制裁大剑取代银河之锤，如果你在 ASA 中使用这个模块，你将能够用制裁大剑施放教宗沙力万的法术，就那个剑“哼”的一声发波，教宗的远程技能。玩得开心

1.21.4 important update
frayed blade from Darksouls3 and zamasu‘s ki blade was newly added，Replacing Infinity Gavel and Wicked Kris respectively.
Important. I've added effects to the tool and weapon swings to make them look less out of place, with effects inspired by Dark Souls 3. I've also added new throws in place of the throwing daggers.

Also optimized the mapping of the greatsword of judgement  so that it no longer looks uncomfortable
新画了黑暗之魂3的破碎刀，代替无尽之锤，以及扎马斯本体的气刃，代替蛇形邪剑。

重要更新：给工具和武器的挥砍加入了特效动画，灵感源于黑暗之魂3。飞刀改成了很帅（我自己这么认为）的气刃飞刀
